packages.description: Read and write Airtable bases, tables, records, cells and comments (workspaces, schema, records, activity, select choices) through your own logged-in airtable.com web session. Uses the web client's internal /v0.3 API in the current tab.

Read and write Asana tasks, projects, sections, comments, tags, teams and users on app.asana.com in your current tab. List and search tasks, create/update/complete/delete tasks, add followers, manage projects and sections, comment on tasks, and list workspaces, users, tags and teams. Uses your own logged-in Asana session.

Read and write Bitbucket Cloud repositories, pull requests, branches, tags, commits, pipelines, source files, workspaces and members on bitbucket.org in your current tab. Uses your own logged-in Bitbucket session.
Read your ClickUp workspace from the current app.clickup.com tab: the signed-in user, workspaces and members, spaces, folders, lists, goals and custom fields. Uses your own logged-in ClickUp session.

Search, read, create, update, delete and comment on Confluence pages, browse spaces, page trees, attachments, versions, labels and user profiles on your *.atlassian.net/wiki site in your current tab. Uses your own logged-in Confluence session.

Read and search messages, manage channels, threads, pinning and reactions, list guilds, members, roles and DMs, upload files and manage your profile on discord.com in your current tab. Uses your own logged-in Discord session.
Read and write repositories, issues, pull requests, comments, labels, releases, workflow runs and notifications on github.com in your current tab. Uses your own logged-in GitHub web session.

List and read GitLab projects, issues, merge requests, notes, branches, commits, files and CI/CD pipelines and jobs, and create, update and merge issues and merge requests, on gitlab.com or your self-hosted instance in your current tab. Uses your own logged-in GitLab session.

Read and search events, list and manage calendars, query free/busy, and read colors and user settings on calendar.google.com in your current tab. Uses your own logged-in Google Calendar session through the page's gapi client.

Read, search, create, rename, trash and delete Google Docs, read their plain text, and manage comments (list, create, reply, resolve, reopen, delete) on docs.google.com in your current tab. Uses your own logged-in Google Docs session through the page's gapi client.

List, search, read, create, copy, move, rename, trash and delete files and folders, manage sharing permissions, and read the account profile and storage quota on drive.google.com in your current tab. Uses your own logged-in Google Drive session through the page's gapi client.

Read Hacker News items (stories, comments, jobs), user profiles, the top/new/best/Ask/Show/job story listings and a story's comments, and post comments or replies on news.ycombinator.com in your current tab. Every tool parses Hacker News' own server-rendered pages from that tab (its CSP allows no cross-origin API), using your own logged-in session.

Search, read, create, update, transition, assign, link and comment on Jira issues, and read projects, agile boards, sprints, issue types, priorities and users on your *.atlassian.net site in your current tab. Uses your own logged-in Jira session.
Search, create and update Linear issues, projects, initiatives, documents, milestones, labels, cycles and teams through your logged-in linear.app session in your current tab.
Search and read Notion pages, blocks and databases, and create or update pages, blocks, database rows and schemas in your current tab. Uses your own logged-in Notion session.

Read npm package, version, dependency, download and dependent data, search the registry, and read user, organization and account settings (own packages, access tokens) on www.npmjs.com in your current tab. Uses your own logged-in npm session where authentication is required.

Read and act on Reddit in your current tab: browse posts and comment threads, search posts and subreddits, read profiles, subscriptions and your inbox, and vote, save, hide, report, submit posts/comments, edit, delete, subscribe and send private messages. Uses your own logged-in Reddit session.

Read and search messages and threads, list channels and users, and send, edit, delete, react to, pin and upload files, plus manage channels and DMs on *.slack.com in your current tab. Uses your own logged-in Slack session.

Read Stack Overflow questions, answers, comments, users, tags and search results (including full-text search, similar/related/linked/featured/unanswered listings and the signed-in user profile) on stackoverflow.com in your current tab.

Read and write Todoist tasks, projects, sections, labels and comments on app.todoist.com in your current tab. List, create, update, complete, reopen and delete items, manage project archiving and shared labels, and list project collaborators. Uses your own logged-in Todoist session.

Read Wikipedia articles, search, sections, categories, links, languages, revisions and diffs, recent changes, page views and featured content, and your own account or a user's contributions on *.wikipedia.org in your current tab. Uses your own logged-in Wikipedia session where authentication is required.
